title: Published Penalty and Low-Income Subsidy Figures for the Ridgecrest RxSecure Plans
content:
The figures below are the ones CMS has published for the contract year and the ones each Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is written at. The late enrollment penalty rate is a percentage of the national base beneficiary premium, added for each month the member went without creditable drug coverage. The rounding basis is how the calculated penalty is rounded before it is billed. The subsidy figures are what a member holding the full low-income subsidy pays.

| Plan | Late enrollment penalty rate (per cent of the national base beneficiary premium, for each uncovered month) | National base beneficiary premium (USD) | Rounding basis for the calculated penalty |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 1.0 | 36.78 | rounded to the nearest ten cents |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 1.0 | 36.78 | rounded to the nearest ten cents |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 1.0 | 36.78 | rounded to the nearest ten cents |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 1.0 | 36.78 | rounded to the nearest ten cents |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 1.0 | 36.78 | rounded to the nearest ten cents |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 1.0 | 36.78 | rounded to the nearest ten cents |

| Plan | Regional low-income premium subsidy benchmark (USD) | Deductible for a member with the full subsidy (USD) | Generic fill copay with the full subsidy (USD) | Brand fill copay with the full subsidy (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 39.42 | 0.0 | 1.6 | 4.8 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 39.42 | 0.0 | 1.6 | 4.8 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 39.42 | 0.0 | 1.6 | 4.8 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 39.42 | 0.0 | 1.6 | 4.8 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 39.42 | 0.0 | 1.6 | 4.8 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 39.42 | 0.0 | 1.6 | 4.8 |

Neither table moves with the plan held: all six Ridgecrest RxSecure plans are written at a penalty rate of 1.0 per cent for each uncovered month, at a national base beneficiary premium of 36.78 USD, at a subsidy benchmark of 39.42 USD, and at subsidy copays of 1.6 USD for a generic fill and 4.8 USD for a brand fill against a subsidy deductible of 0.0 USD. What varies between one member and another is the count of uncovered months CMS supplies and the subsidy level CMS has told the plan to apply, never these published figures.
